full_name_ar: خالد بن زيد الأنصاري أدرك جماعة
bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat (vol. 4, p. 202, section of the Followers) says Khalid ibn Zayd al-Ansari met a group of the Prophet's Companions, including Anas ibn Malik, and often narrated reports in mursal form. Mujammi' ibn Yahya, who calls him his paternal uncle, narrates from him; Ibn Hibban cites, via Abu Ya'la, a mursal report that whoever pays zakat, hosts the guest and gives in calamity is free of stinginess. Note: 'Abu Ya'la' in this entry is Ibn Hibban's transmitter, not this man's kunya.

research_evidence: إِسْمَاعِيل بن إِبْرَاهِيم بن مُحَمَّد بن طَلْحَة الْقرشِي حجازي يروي عَن مُعَاوِيَة روى عَنهُ مُحَمَّد بْن إِسْحَاق
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: إسماعيل بن إبراهيم السلمي ويقال الش
bio: Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil lists Isma'il bin Ibrahim al-Sulami, also called al-Shaybani, who narrated from Ibn Abbas; Ya'qub bin Khalid and Muhammad bin Talha bin Yazid bin Rukana narrated from him. Some narrators call him Ibrahim bin Isma'il, and he is counted among the Medinans.
research_students: Muhammad bin Talha bin Yazid bin Rukana
research_evidence: إسماعيل بن إبراهيم السلمي ويقال الشيباني روى عن ابن عباس روى عنه يعقوب بن خالد
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: جرير بن أبي عطاء القرشي مولى بني
bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat lists Jarir bin Abi Ata al-Qurashi, mawla of Banu Zuhra, a Hijazi who narrated from Ibn Umar, with al-Zuhri narrating from him; al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir and Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil give the same. Ibn Adi's al-Kamil (quoted by Ibn al-Jawzi's al-Du'afa) says he is not well known and has no musnad hadith.
research_evidence: جرير بْن أبي عَطاء الْقرشِي مولى بنى زهرَة حجازي يروي عَن بْن عمر روى عَنهُ الزُّهْرِيّ
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: الحارث بن سعد بن أبي ذباب القرشي
bio: The page is titled al-Harith bin Sa'd bin Abi Dhubab al-Qurashi. Ibn Hibban's Mashahir Ulama al-Amsar (spelling the father Sa'id) calls him al-Qurashi, a cousin of Abu Hurayra al-Dawsi, whom Umar bin al-Khattab sent as a collector of zakat. Al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir (as al-Harith bin Sa'd bin Abi Dhubab al-Dawsi al-Hijazi) also says Umar sent him as a collector and that he heard Abu Hurayra.
research_evidence: الحارث بن سعيد بن أبى ذباب القرشي بن عم أبى هريرة الدوسي ممن كان بعثه عمر بن الخطاب مصدقا
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir lists Salit bin Salit, who heard Uthman bin Affan; Ibn Sirin narrated from him and he is counted among the people of the Hijaz. Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil adds that he narrated from Abdullah bin Umar, with Muhammad bin Sirin narrating from him.
research_evidence: سليط بْن سليط، سَمِعَ عثمان بْن عفان، روى عَنْهُ ابْن سيرين، يعد فِي أهل الحجاز.
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عمر بن عبد الرحمن بن جرهد بن خويل
bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat lists Umar bin Abd al-Rahman bin Jarhad bin Khuwaylid al-Aslami al-Hijazi, brother of Zur'a. Al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir says he saw Jabir, and Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil says he saw Jabir bin Abdullah and that Ibn Harmala narrated from him.
research_evidence: عمر بْن عَبْد الرَّحْمَن بْن جرهد بْن خويلد الْأَسْلَمِيّ الْحِجَازِي أَخُو زرْعَة
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: مسلم بن مرة بن عمرو بن عبد الله
bio: Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil lists Muslim bin Murra bin Amr bin Abdullah al-Jumahi al-Qurashi, counted among the people of the Hijaz, who narrated from Ibn Umar. Al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir says his son Muhammad narrated from him, and Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat names Yahya bin Sa'id al-Ansari as narrating from him.
research_evidence: مسلم بن مرة بن عمرو بن عبد الله الجمحى القرشى يعد في أهل الحجاز روى عن ابن عمر
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: مغيرة بن سعيد بن نوفل الحجازي
bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat lists Mughira bin Sa'id bin Nawfal al-Hijazi, who narrated from Shaddad bin Aws; Kathir bin Zayd narrated from him.
research_evidence: مُغيرَة بن سعيد بن نَوْفَل الْحِجَازِي يروي عَن شَدَّاد بن أَوْس روى عَنهُ كثير بن زيد
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: نافع بن سرجس الحجازي مولى بني سباع
bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat lists Nafi' bin Sarjis al-Hijazi, mawla of Banu Siba', with the kunya Abu Sa'id; Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil gives his kunya as Abu Suwayd or Abu Sa'id. Al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir says he heard Abu Waqid al-Laythi and Ibn Khuthaym narrated from him. Ibn Sa'd's al-Tabaqat al-Kubra calls him trustworthy (thiqa) with few hadith.
research_evidence: نَافِع بن سرجس الْحِجَازِي مولى بني سِبَاع كنيته أَبُو سعيد
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat lists Warqa' al-Rasibi, also called al-Azdi, who narrated from Ibn Umar; Abu al-Salil narrated from him.
research_evidence: وَرْقَاء الرَّاسِبِي وَيُقَال الْأَزْدِيّ يروي عَن بْن عمر روى عَنهُ أَبُو السَّلِيل
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat lists Walan bin Bayhas al-Adawi, also called Walan bin Qirfa, who narrated from Hudhayfa bin al-Yaman; al-Bara bin Nawfal narrated from him. Al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir and Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil give the same, the latter calling the student Abu Hunayda al-Bara bin Nawfal.
research_evidence: والان بن بيهس الْعَدوي وَقد قيل والان بن قرفة يروي عَن حُذَيْفَة بن الْيَمَان روى عَنهُ الْبَراء بن نَوْفَل
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir lists Walan al-Hanafi, who heard Ibn Mas'ud on the matter of a slaughter done by a boy; the chain cited runs through Isma'il bin Sumay' from Malik bin Umayr. Ahmad bin Hanbal (al-Jami' li-Ulum al-Imam Ahmad) discusses Walan al-Hanafi al-Ijli and doubts he is the same Walan from whom al-Nadr bin Shumayl's chain narrates.
research_evidence: والان الحنفِي سَمِعَ ابْن مَسْعُود فِي ذبيحة الصبي قَالَ لا بأس به
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat lists Wiqa' bin Shurahbil, who narrated from Anas; his hadith is held by the Egyptians, and Bakr bin Sawada narrated from him.
research_evidence: وقاء بن شرَاحِيل يروي عَن أنس حَدِيثه عِنْد المصريين روى عَنهُ بكر بن سوَادَة
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir says Wazi' bin Abdullah al-Kilabi saw Anas bin Malik praying in a church, and Yusuf Abu Ma'shar narrated from him. Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat calls him a shaykh narrating from Anas bin Malik, distinct from al-Wazi' bin Nafi', with Abu Ma'shar al-Bara Yusuf bin Yazid narrating from him; Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil agrees.
research_students: Abu Ma'shar Yusuf bin Yazid al-Bara
research_evidence: وازع بن عبد الله الْكلابِي شيخ يروي عَن أنس بْن مَالك وَلَيْسَ هَذَا بالوازع بن نَافِع
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat lists Wathima al-Nasri, who narrated from Abu Hurayra the hadith 'If someone whose religion and character you are pleased with comes to you, marry him'. Muhammad bin Ajlan narrated from him via Abd al-Hamid bin Sulayman, whom Ibn Hibban considers of no standing.
research_evidence: وَثِيمَةُ النَّصْرِيُّ يَرْوِي عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَن النَّبِي صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: وردان الصائغ الرومي مولى لأبي مسعود
bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat lists Wardan al-Sa'igh al-Rumi, mawla of Abu Mas'ud, who narrated from Ibn Umar; Ibn Uyayna narrated from him.

dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat lists Wardan, mawla of Amr bin al-As, who narrated from Mu'awiya bin Abi Sufyan, with Ali bin Zayd bin Jud'an narrating from him. Ibn Sa'd's al-Tabaqat al-Kubra gives his kunya as Abu Ubaydullah and says the Wardan market in Egypt was named after him. Ibn Manzur's Mukhtasar Tarikh Dimashq says he was taken captive from Isfahan, came to Damascus in Mu'awiya's time, and was killed by the Byzantines at al-Burullus in 53 AH.
research_evidence: وردان أبو عبيد ويقال أبو عثمان مولى عمرو بن العاص السهمي من سبي أصبهان، قدم دمشق في أيام معاوية

bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat lists Hisham bin Isma'il, without further lineage, who narrated from Mu'awiya bin Abi Sufyan and was governor of Medina; Muhammad bin Yahya bin Habban narrated from him.
research_evidence: هِشَام بن إِسْمَاعِيل يروي عَن مُعَاوِيَة بْن أبي سُفْيَان وَكَانَ واليا بِالْمَدِينَةِ روى عَنهُ مُحَمَّد بن يحيى بن حبَان
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat lists Hisham bin Yusuf, a shaykh who narrated from the companion Abdullah bin Busr, with Hushaym narrating from him; al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir gives the same. He is distinct from Hisham bin Yusuf al-San'ani, the later judge of San'a who appears on the same page.
research_evidence: هِشَام بن يُوسُف شيخ يروي عَن عَبْد الله بْن بسر روى عَنهُ هشيم
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: هشام بن حبيش بن خالد بن الأشعر ال
bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat lists Hisham bin Hubaysh bin Khalid bin al-Ash'ar al-Khuza'i, who narrated from Umar and Ibn Umar; his son Hizam bin Hisham narrated from him. Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil calls him a Hijazi who lived at Qudayd, and Ibn Manzur's Mukhtasar Tarikh Dimashq gives his kunya as Abu Hizam al-Khuza'i al-Qudaydi. Ibn al-Athir's Usd al-Ghaba also has an entry on him discussing whether he was a companion.
research_evidence: هِشَام بن حُبَيْش بن خَالِد بن الْأَشْعر الْخُزَاعِيّ يروي عَن عمر وَابْن عمر روى عَنهُ ابْنه حزَام بن هِشَام
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat lists Hisham bin Ibrahim, who narrated from Ibn Umar; al-Mughira bin Muslim narrated from him. Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil and Ibn al-Jawzi's al-Du'afa list a Hisham bin Abi Ibrahim with the same teacher and student and call him unknown (majhul).
research_evidence: هِشَام بن إِبْرَاهِيم يروي عَن بن عمر روى عَنهُ الْمُغيرَة بْن مُسلم
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil lists Hisham bin Hubaysh bin Khalid bin al-Ash'ar al-Khuza'i, a Hijazi and father of Hizam bin Hisham, who lived at Qudayd. Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat says he narrated from Umar and Ibn Umar, with his son Hizam narrating from him. This appears to be the same person as the entry Hisham bin Hubaysh bin Khalid.
research_evidence: هشام بن حبيش بن خالد بن الاشعر الخزاعى حجازى والد حزام بن هشام كان ينزل قديد
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat lists Hisham bin al-Hakam al-Thaqafi, who narrated from Abd al-Rahman bin Abi Aqil; his son al-Hakam bin Hisham narrated from him. Al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir and Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil give the same.
research_evidence: هِشَام بْن الحكم الثَّقَفِيّ يروي عَن عَبْد الرَّحْمَن بن أَبى عقيل روى عَنهُ الحكم بن هِشَام
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil lists Hilal al-Mazini, who narrated from Suwayd bin Muqarrin; Abu Hamza, a neighbour of Shu'ba, narrated from him. Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat notes that Suwayd bin Muqarrin was a companion, and al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir also records him narrating from Suwayd bin Muqarrin.
research_evidence: هلال المازنى روى عن سويد بن مقرن روى عنه أبو حمزة جار لشعبة
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat lists Hilal bin Abi Hilal, without further lineage, who narrated from Anas bin Malik; Yahya bin al-Mutawakkil narrated from him. The same page also lists other men of this name (a companion Hilal bin Abi Hilal al-Aslami in Usd al-Ghaba, and Hilal bin Abi Hilal al-Madhhiji in al-Thiqat and al-Tarikh al-Kabir) as separate entries.
research_evidence: هِلَال بن أبي هِلَال يروي عَن أنس بْن مَالك روى عَنهُ يحيى بن المتَوَكل
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: هلال بن سويد الأحمري أبو المعلي
bio: Al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir lists him as Hilal ibn Suwayd al-Ahmari Abu al-Mu'alla, from whom Marwan ibn Mu'awiya transmitted. Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat says he transmitted from Anas ibn Malik. Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil calls him the father of al-Mu'alla ibn Hilal.
research_evidence: هِلَال بن سُوَيْد الأحمري كنيته أَبُو الْمُعَلَّى روى عَن أنس بن مَالك روى عَنهُ مَرْوَان بْن مُعَاوِيَة
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil and Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat say this Hilal ibn Umayya transmitted from Uthman ibn Affan and that Qatada transmitted from him. Al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir records his report from Uthman about the one who listens silently. The same page also carries an Usd al-Ghaba entry for the Companion Hilal ibn Umayya ibn Amir al-Waqifi, who is a different person.
research_evidence: هلال بن امية روى عن عثمان بن عفان روى عنه قتادة سمعت أبي يقول ذلك
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil calls him a Basran who transmitted from a man of Banu Hashim from the Prophet. Al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir names Wasil, mawla of Abu Uyayna, as his student. Ibn Hibban lists him in al-Thiqat and adds al-Jurayri among those who transmitted from him.
research_evidence: هلال أبو الورد العتكى بصرى روى عن رجل من بنى هاشم عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وسلم روى عنه واصل مولى أبي عيينة
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat lists al-Haytham ibn Hubaysh al-Nakha'i as transmitting from Ibn Umar. It names Abu Ishaq al-Hamdani and Salama ibn Kuhayl as those who transmitted from him.
research_evidence: الْهَيْثَم بن حُبَيْش النَّخعِيّ يروي عَن بْن عمر روى عَنهُ أَبُو إِسْحَاق الْهَمدَانِي وَسَلَمَة بن كهيل
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat (vol. 5, p. 507, chapter of Ha) lists al-Haytham ibn 'Abbad as narrating from Anas ibn Malik, with Yahya ibn al-Yaman narrating from him. No death year is given.
research_evidence: الْهَيْثَم بن عباد يروي عَن أنس بْن مَالك روى عَنهُ يحيى بن الْيَمَان
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir and Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat both list Harun ibn al-Asamm as transmitting from Umar ibn al-Khattab. Both name Kahmas ibn al-Hasan as his student.

dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir, Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil and Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat say he transmitted from Ibn Umar and that Abd al-Malik transmitted from him. Ibn Hibban names that student as Abd al-Malik ibn Harun. Abu Hatim al-Razi called him majhul (unknown), as quoted in al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil and Ibn al-Jawzi's al-Du'afa wa al-Matrukin.
research_evidence: هارون بن أبي زياد التميمي روى عن ابن عمر روى عنه عبد الملك سمعت أبي يقول ذلك ويقول: هو مجهول
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat lists Harun ibn Abi Dawud al-Habati, who reported visiting Anas ibn Malik in his illness and hearing from him a hadith on the reward of visiting the sick. Ibn Hibban names his brother Hilal ibn Abi Dawud al-Habati as transmitting from him.
research_evidence: هَارُونُ بْنُ أَبِي دَاوُدَ الْحَبَطِيُّ قَالَ أَتَيْنَا أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالك فِي مَرضه
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat lists Hani' al-Khawlani as transmitting from Abu Dharr. It names his son Sa'id ibn Hani' as transmitting from him.
research_evidence: هَانِئ الْخَولَانِيّ يروي عَن أبي ذَر روى عَنهُ ابْنه سعيد بن هَانِئ
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: هانئ بن عروة بن فروة بن مسيك المر
bio: Al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir identifies Hani' ibn Urwa al-Muradi as the father of Yahya ibn Hani' and counts him among the Kufans. Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat gives his lineage as Hani' ibn Urwa ibn Farwa ibn Musayk al-Muradi and says he transmitted mursal reports. Ibn Hibban names Umara ibn Uqba ibn Abi Mu'ayt as transmitting from him.

dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat lists Hani' ibn Thubayb al-Hadrami as transmitting from Ibn Umar. It names Abu Janab al-Qassab as transmitting from him.

dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil and al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir both list Hani' al-Dari as transmitting from Umar ibn al-Khattab. He reported Umar's saying that people were left on the clearest path, unless the Quran was interpreted wrongly and fought over.
research_evidence: هانئ الدارى روى عن عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه أنه قال تركتم على اوضح الطريق
dod_s: c. 728 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat lists Hammam ibn Subayh as transmitting from Abd Allah ibn Umar. It names Ma'mar ibn Rashid as transmitting from him.
